# CUDA Graphs — Capture and Replay

## Thesis

**CUDA Graphs** record GPU work once and replay it with less CPU launch overhead. Useful when shapes are static. **No GPU timings on this host.**

## Mental model

```text
  capture → instantiate → launch repeatedly
```

## Worked examples

```cuda
cudaStreamBeginCapture(stream, cudaStreamCaptureModeGlobal);
my_kernel<<<grid, block, 0, stream>>>(...);
cudaStreamEndCapture(stream, &graph);
cudaGraphInstantiate(&exec, graph, NULL, NULL, 0);
cudaGraphLaunch(exec, stream);
```

PyTorch: `torch.cuda.make_graphed_callables` when shapes are fixed.

## Trap

**Capturing across host syncs** or with dynamic shapes. Graphs fail or help little.

## Boring rule

Use graphs only after a profiler shows launch overhead and shapes are stable.

## Try this

1. Nsight Systems graphed vs ungated loops on a GPU box.
2. Read CUDA Programming Guide — Graphs.
3. Check current vLLM/TensorRT graph toggles.
